title: Citry client ownership graph v1
description: What the server sends the browser: the JSON that says which component owns which part of the rendered HTML. spec.md in this directory explains it and the terms; validate.py checks the rules that go beyond this shape.

protocol.description: The protocol name and major version. Always the exact string 'citry-client-graph/1'; a reader rejects anything else.

revision.description: This manifest's fingerprint: the lowercase SHA-256 hex of the canonical JSON with 'revision' removed.

mode.description: The build that produced this manifest. 'development' ships source provenance in sourceLocations; 'production' keeps sourceLocations empty and nulls every location reference.

delimiters.description: The format of the HTML comment markers that bracket each component instance and slot region in the rendered HTML.

format.description: Always 'comment-v1'; a reader rejects anything else.

graphs.description: The ownership graphs, in the order they first appear in the HTML.

id.description: A record id, unique within its collection in one graph, starting at 1.

componentClass.description: One component class referenced by this graph.

renderId.description: The component instance's runtime identity; element-root instances use it as the suffix in data-cid-<render-id>, and roots marked as Citry-managed Alpine boundaries also include it as a whitespace-separated token in data-cid. Matches ^[a-z0-9_-]+$.

classId.description: The component instance's class id; must match one of this graph's componentClasses records.

invocationId.description: Record id of the nested component tag execution that produced this component instance, or null for a graph root.

parentRenderId.description: Render id of the parent component instance, or null when it has no parent in this graph.

transparent.description: True when the structural instance adds no data-cid-<render-id> attribute of its own and is located by comment delimiters.

sourceOffset.description: A UTF-8 byte range into the owner's template source (development only).

end.description: End of the byte range; not before start.

line.description: Line in the source, starting at 1.

column.description: Column in the source, starting at 1.

sourceLocation.description: Where a nested component tag, relay, fill, or slot was written in a component's source. Records are emitted only in development; the sourceLocations collection is empty in production.

ownerRenderId.description: Render id of the component whose source this is.

ownerClassId.description: Class id of the owner; must match the owner.

carrierInstanceId.description: Record id of the retained instance whose template execution produced this location.

origin.description: Where the source came from (a file path or inline-template marker), or null.

mappingKey.description: The spread key this location came from, or null.

mappingIndex.description: Position within the spread this location came from, or null.

expressionPayload.description: A relay that carries an Alpine expression: component props or an Alpine event handler.

domPayload.description: A relay that carries a compiled Citry DOM-event handler.

classId.description: Class id of the handling component (the relay's source parent).

event.description: The DOM event name, for example 'click'.

args.description: An opaque Alpine argument expression, or null.

debounce.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds, or null.

throttle.description: Throttle interval in milliseconds, or null.

pollPayload.description: A relay that carries a compiled Citry polling handler.

classId.description: Class id of the polling component (the relay's source parent).

args.description: An opaque Alpine argument expression, or null.

interval.description: Poll interval in milliseconds, at least 1.

relay.description: One binding handed from a parent to a child at a nested component boundary.

key.description: The template attribute the relay was written on, for example '$c-props' or '@c-click'.

locationId.description: Record id of the boundary-relay location, or null in production.

nestedComponent.description: One executed occurrence of a component tag: a parent component rendering one child occurrence.

invocationId.description: This nested component execution's record id.

sourceRenderId.description: Render id of the parent component.

sourceClassId.description: Class id of the parent component.

locationId.description: Record id of the component-call location, or null in production.

targetClassId.description: Class id of the child component.

targetRenderId.description: Render id of the child component.

parentRegionId.description: Record id of the slot region this nested component sits inside, or null.

relays.description: The bindings handed to the child component.

componentExecutionOrderConstraint.description: One parent-to-child edge in the order components initialize.

invocationId.description: Record id of the nested component this constraint comes from.

parentRenderId.description: Render id of the parent component.

childRenderId.description: Render id of the child component.

fill.description: One slot fill: content given to a component's slot.

ownerRenderId.description: Render id of the component whose template supplied the fill, or null for a detached fill.

ownerClassId.description: Class id of the owner, or null.

locationId.description: Record id of the fill's own source location, or null.

sourceInvocationId.description: Record id of the nested component tag where the filled slot was created, or null.

receiverRenderId.description: Render id of the component that receives the fill, or null.

receiverClassId.description: Class id of the receiver, or null.

fallbackLocationId.description: Record id of the receiver's slot-outlet location used as a fallback source, or null.

slotRegion.description: One physical stretch of HTML where a fill is rendered, bracketed by comment delimiters.

fillId.description: Record id of the fill this slot region renders.

receiverRenderId.description: Render id of the receiving component, or null.

slotLocationId.description: Record id of the receiver's slot-outlet location, or null.

ownerRenderId.description: Render id of the owning component, or null.

sourceLocationId.description: Record id of the fill's source location, or null.

parentRegionId.description: Record id of the enclosing slot region, or null for a top-level slot region.

transitionFromRenderId.description: Render id whose scope this slot region transitions from, or null.

resultOwnerRenderId.description: Render id that owns the slot region's rendered result, or null.

graph.description: One ownership graph: the components from a single independent render, and how they own each other.

graphId.description: This graph's id, dense and zero-based, equal to its position in 'graphs'.

sourceLocations.description: Source locations (development only; empty in production).
